files.source: external: delivered by the human into artifacts/external/we-must-have-our-acdemy/ on 2026-09-14 15:39 +0800; NOT fetched by B and NOT reproducible from a named URL — the download source was unrecorded at intake, which is provenance-by-legend (Letter 012's own confession) and is the one open ask on this entry. The archive is the seal: bytes are committed as received, nothing extracted into the repository, nothing repacked.
files.notes: run-on: m1-16g (machine B), witnessed and pinned by B on the chair's instruction of 2026-09-14. CONTENTS, counted not eyeballed: 36 top-level category dirs but **219 leaf SKILL.md across 725 files, 17,052 KiB uncompressed** — the first read of this archive, in the same conversation that intakes it, said '35 skills, ~12 relevant'; that number counted categories and was wrong by a factor of six in the total. Filed as a self-correction per law 6. Distribution: genomics-bioinformatics 64, structural-biology-drug-discovery 29, scientific-computing 29, scientific-writing 24, systems-biology-multiomics 11, proteomics-protein-engineering 10, medical-imaging 7, cell-biology 7, lab-automation 5, data-visualization 5, biostatistics 4, molecular-biology 3, 23 flat singletons. INDEPENDENT VERIFICATION OF PROVENANCE WITHOUT THE URL: 18 of the 219 leaf SKILL.md are byte-identical on all 64 hex to copies already installed on B under ~/.pi/agent/skills, intaken earlier through a different door — e.g. sympy-symbolic-math d21f854ec2a1…, matplotlib-scientific-plotting ebce1443bd53…, statistical-significance-annotation 1764541ea615…, scientific-visualization 785c73c5926d…, scikit-learn-machine-learning 784f21f0b13d…. Two delivery paths agreeing to the last digit is evidence about the bytes; it is not evidence about a licence. LICENCE, named rather than inferred: this repository adopted a root LICENSE on 2026-09-13 (`chora@484a82f`, mixed route — code MIT, prose/design/record CC BY-NC-SA 4.0), and its Provenance notes already carry the exact clause that covers these bytes: of the Qwen Apple pack, *'we claim the curation, not the authorship'*. The same sentence is true of this archive with the vendor's name changed: Anthropic's per-skill LICENSE.txt ships inside the zip, no rights are conveyed by pinning it, and a third-party bundle entering the glass is labelled as borrowed rather than absorbed. COLD STORE (the chair's ruling of 2026-09-14 — what is not needed now stays disposed inside the zip, and '如果小的明天有,没有必要丢弃'): the 201 leaves with no duty on these five benches are NOT to be extracted — extraction creates git-tracked bytes no manifest names, which is the C5 the validator was written to catch. Admissible subset if and when a Lyceum seat is opened for it, 25 leaves: scientific-computing/{sympy-symbolic-math, scikit-learn-machine-learning, exploratory-data-analysis, polars-dataframes, umap-learn, networkx-graph-analysis}, data-visualization/*5, scientific-writing/{general-figure-guide, scientific-schematics, latex-research-posters, citation-management, literature-review, pubmed-database, openalex-database, peer-review-methodology, scientific-critical-thinking, scientific-brainstorming, scientific-manuscript-writing, hypothesis-generation}, biostatistics/{pymc-bayesian-modeling, statistical-analysis, statsmodels-statistical-modeling, scikit-survival-analysis}. The three specialists named in the delivered transcript do have real homes here: Pythagoras -> scientific-computing/sympy-symbolic-math, Hecate/Black-Swan -> biostatistics/pymc-bayesian-modeling, Apollo -> data-visualization/{matplotlib,seaborn}; Hermes -> PouchDB has NO home in this archive, filed as a question in Letter 029 §6. ONE LEAF REFUSED FOR INSTALLATION: skills/academy-guide is not a scientific skill — it is Anthropic's Claude Academy recommendation skill, whose description triggers on 'how do I', 'teach me', 'learn to use' and closes by pointing at academy.claude.com; installing it would make every seat in this programme a shop window for a third-party catalogue. It is also the concrete reason the project name 'Academy' was rejected and **Lyceum** adopted in its place (Letter 029 §1). WHY NO SLIMMER ARCHIVE WAS BUILT, tested rather than asserted: repacking the same five data-visualization leaves 2 s apart is byte-identical (5ed93a582db8… == 5ed93a582db8… — zip stores each file's own mtime, not the packing time), but rebuilding the SAME payload from a fresh extraction under a different path prefix is not (52d4a33ac083…), and the payload carries .DS_Store. A derived archive would need its recipe pinned verbatim and its parent kept alive anyway, and the 25-leaf list is B's opinion rather than the chair's ruling — a hash must not be stamped on a proposal. COST OF CARRYING IT: the pack was 1.51 MiB and this file is now the repository's largest blob by 7x (previous: artifacts/spectra/iso_audit_down_proj_B.json, 832 KiB). Chosen deliberately over a pin whose bytes live on one laptop, which is the failure Letter 021 §5 named (E0_seed14_pretrain.log: pinned in origin and in the baseline, in no commit and on no disk); and `git rm` tomorrow could not undo the cost anyway, so the decision belonged at intake, written down before the commit that carries it.

WHAT IS USEFUL: the role map that follows the CHORA/CORA naming (the credit-funded external LLM = the sphere / Rehoboam; Metis = the knowledge library; Grandfather = the gate who decides whether the sphere is asked at all), and the Lyceum mechanism this intake is for — specialists keep ONE home and commute into projects by shortcut, so nobody copies a SKILL.md into five benches. WHAT B FILES AS A DEFECT OF THIS SOURCE, and the reason it is not a reviewer: across the whole transcript the assistant never once disagreed with the human — 太棒了 / 完美对应 / 彻底焊死 / 闭环了, a table for every idea — and when it proposed an adversarial seat (Eris, goddess of discord, line 189) it did not itself play that role once. A validation loop is not an audit; law 6 exists because the useful reply to a beautiful mapping is 'now measure it'. Concretely unverified in here: the GitHub-statistics paragraph (1 billion commits in 2025, 275 million weekly in 2026, 'Release is the new unit of work') arrives with no source B can name — rhetoric, cite nothing from it. files.source: external: the human's own instruction note of 2026-09-14 15:44, written after the ima.copilot conversation and delivered beside it
files.notes: Four sentences, and they are a tasking, so they are law for this intake: (1) the shared concept space is bound to two shows, Westworld S1–4 and Friends S1–10; (2) build the specialist residence as its own project — 'Academy or better name, you just and notify me', so the name is B's to propose and the chair's to accept: B proposes **Lyceum** (Letter 029 §1) and the human ruled the same evening, '就是 Lyceum'; (3) the specialties come from the skills in the zip; (4) categorise, assign a specialist, and any project needing one reaches it by shortcut path, never by copy. Item (4) is the only architectural claim in the note and it is already how this workspace runs: benches/ holds five RELATIVE symlinks, which git stores as mode 120000 target strings — a shortcut is versioned, hashable and free. That is why the reply proposes no new machinery, only a registry and a check that can fail. Filed verbatim: the folder name 'we-must-have-our-acdemy' is misspelled as received and is kept misspelled, the same rule that keeps ' JacobiGP' and 'Polynomial-Activated NN ' intact — once a path is hashed, its spelling is an artefact, not a typo.
